intro.text:
The old cemetery lies beneath a permanent veil of mist. Its headstones are so worn that most names have vanished. At the far end stands a cathedral of gray stone, half-sunken into the earth.

No birds perch on its roof. No wind moves through its broken windows.

It is called the Silent Cathedral because its bells have not rung in three hundred years.

Lady Yseld Mourne waits by the entrance, dressed in black travel clothes, her face pale but composed.

"Yes," she says before you can accuse her. "I bought the crown."

She looks toward the cathedral doors.

"But the spirit said not to wake the king. They said it is to keep him bound. Then the Ashen Herald visited me. I do not know what is right or wrong anymore. Decide for yourself. The Crown lies deep beneath the cathedral."

As she speaks, the cathedral doors open by themselves.

Inside, the nave is full of kneeling dead.

Find and ring the three funeral bells. This will open the stairs down.

outro.text:
The third bell rings.

Its sound rolls through the cathedral like thunder beneath stone.

The kneeling dead lower their heads. The altar cracks from top to bottom, revealing a hidden stairway spiraling into the dark.

Lady Yseld staggers as blood runs from her nose.

"I saw him," she whispers. "The first king. He was not murdered."

She grips the edge of the broken altar.

"He was crowned after death. The crown was made to keep him ruling from the grave."

The bells ring again, though no one touches them.

Far below, something answers.

A slow metallic sound.

Like a crown being lifted from stone.

storyTriggers.title: The Silent Nave
storyTriggers.text: The nave opens around a vast, dust-choked organ. The dead kneel between broken pews, heads bowed toward an altar that has not heard a hymn in centuries.

storyTriggers.title: Bell-Ringer Vestry
storyTriggers.text: Ropes hang here like nooses. A black funeral bell rests among cracked reliquaries, waiting for a hand brave enough to carry it back to the nave.

storyTriggers.title: Lady Mourne Chapel
storyTriggers.text: The Mourne family chapel smells of old incense and wet stone. Names have been scratched from the walls, but one line remains: The heir must choose the silence or the crown.

storyTriggers.title: The Cracked Altar
storyTriggers.text: The altar below the cathedral is split by hairline cracks. Every bell in your pack trembles toward it. Beneath the stone, something royal waits for sound.
